_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. There are two Disk II drives and a hard disk controller. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Disk II drive 1
slots.help: Disk images for drive 1 (slot 6). Accepted are DOS-order images (.dsk, .do), ProDOS-order images (.po), nibble images (.nib), .woz images and 140K .2mg images. The machine starts from the first one. The order here is the order the Next Disk 1 input goes through.

slots.title: Disk II drive 2
slots.help: Disk images for drive 2. The first one is in the drive when the machine starts, and the Next Disk 2 input goes through the rest.

slots.title: Hard disk
slots.help: Up to two ProDOS hard disk images, on a controller card in slot 7. What the machine writes is kept in memory and saved in savestates. The file itself is never changed.
